Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for assay CHEMBL3705858. Join molecule_dictionary to activities via molregno, and join assays via assay_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value and standard_relation are not null. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
